objective:
Goal: a page offering to download the article as a PDF is shown. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "Click this, and you’ll see some options – you’ll want to click on “Download as PDF”.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

PRIMARY: reach a page offering to download the article as a PDF; role=link; text="Download as PDF" | HINTS: container=Print/export section of Page tools menu
actions.instr: Clicking Download as PDF link in the print or export section
